name: 5-DM-DOM
summary: 5-DM-DOM, also known as 5-O-desmethyl-DOM, 5-OH-DOM, or 5-hydroxy-2-methoxy-4-methylamphetamine (5-HMMP), is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to the DOx psychedelic DOM (2,5-dimethoxy-4-methylamphetamine; STP). It has been identified as an active metabolite of DOM in animals.
